verse.verse_1: Have you seen him who denies Ad-Din
verse.verse_2: That is he who repulses the orphan,
verse.verse_3: And urges not the feeding of Al-Miskin.
verse.verse_4: So, woe unto those performers of Salah,
verse.verse_5: Those who with their Salah are Sahun.
verse.verse_6: Those who do good deeds only to be seen,
